# ufbx 0.17.1

Unmodified `ufbx.c`, `ufbx.h`, and `LICENSE` from the pinned upstream tag:
https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx/tree/v0.17.1

Used only by the native Qt animation importer. No runtime DLL or Blender installation
is required. Geometry, embedded content, and external file loading are disabled;
memory, hierarchy, input size, duration and decoded sample counts are bounded.
The library is available under the MIT or public-domain alternatives in LICENSE.
